description: SDG 6.3.1 Proportion of Safely Treated Domestic Wastewater Flows is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by National Planning Council. This dataset shows the percentage of domestic wastewater flows generated in the State of Qatar that are safely treated before being discharged or reused, covering the period from 2020 to 2024. Domestic wastewater covers the flows produced by households and by service activities of a comparable nature, including blackwater and greywater. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher National Planning Council. Its tags are Clean Water and Sanitation, sanitation. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-08-20 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
